question: Which current dependency changes require replay before pinned historical native acceptance can inform later work, without claiming current acceptance?

types.historical: pinned successful run with fixture, consumer, workflow and budget coordinates
types.current: current ref snapshot of the same dependency coordinate family
types.frontier: finite ordered list of changed dependency coordinates

quantifier: all eight fixed canonical controls plus one fresh exact and one fresh multi-drift reuse
arithmetic_domain: finite nonnegative byte/work budgets and exact string/blob equality only
evaluation: an unrelated commit change with identical dependency pins leaves the frontier empty
fixture, consumer, workflow and budget drift are reported separately
missing current evidence remains an obstruction
a fresh dependency family reuses the relation
